pages.title: Eval Gate

items.heading: Metrics follow the task
items.body: Each prediction task can choose its own comparison metric.

items.heading: Manual promote is allowed
items.body: A registered version can be forced to production after contract checks.

items.heading: Production can be pinned
items.body: While pinned, scheduled evaluation still runs but does not promote.
